goal: Improve real TP=1 G11 packed-NVFP4 MoE performance versus flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe.

probe_task08_end_to_end.py: Added --reference-first to run the FlashInfer oracle before the candidate pipeline.
Added --candidate-warmup-runs to discard cold candidate pipeline launches before the measured correctness run.
Recorded reference_order and candidate_warmup_runs in probe JSON output.

findings.finding: The previous clean postsync and metadata/legacy correctness failures were cold-launch/order effects, not a layout mismatch.
findings.conclusion: Task08 UMMA BMM probes need one discarded candidate warmup or a reference-first run before correctness assertions. Do not classify metadata SwiGLU or clean postsync GEMM2 as incorrect from a cold first launch alone.

findings.finding: metadata_valid_slots SwiGLU matches legacy and is end-to-end correct after the same candidate warmup.
findings.conclusion: Use metadata_valid_slots for current staged-pipeline benchmarking; legacy_count_dense is no longer needed as the default diagnostic workaround.

findings.finding: The best currently rechecked staged BMM path is still far behind FlashInfer.
findings.conclusion: The staged BMM bridge is about 245x faster than the formal scalar kernel.py path but still about 2.0x slower than FlashInfer. The next high-leverage work is integrating a staged BMM special path into kernel.py and then eliminating large memory traffic, especially GEMM2_out plus final scatter and the standalone SwiGLU requant pass.

recommended_next_steps: Keep --candidate-warmup-runs 1 for task08 staged-pipeline correctness and short benchmarks.
Promote the diagnostic warp-shuffle post-load-sync plus post-epilogue-sync GEMM2 only after repeated warmup correctness runs.
Move the staged BMM path behind an exact G11 TP=1 fast path in kernel.py so the formal evaluator improves from the scalar baseline.
After integration, pursue GEMM2/final-scatter fusion or SwiGLU-to-GEMM2 fusion; micro-optimizing clears is too small and previously unstable.

quality_gate.reason: Correctness diagnosis improved and the best staged BMM path is now reproducibly PASS after warmup, but no current path beats flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe.
